heading.zh-Hant: 出身與航空養成
heading.en: Origins and training in aviation

body.zh-Hant: 據空軍司令部的歷任總司令介紹，王叔銘為山東諸城人，考入黃埔軍校第一期，畢業後轉習航空，進入廣東航校第一期，其後獲選送蘇俄航校與中央航校高級班深造。他歷任航校教官、路司令、航委會副主任與空軍總司令部副總司令，民國41年升任空軍總司令，民國46年升任參謀總長。
body.en: The Republic of China Air Force profile of its commanders says Wang Shuming was a native of Zhucheng, Shandong, who entered the first class of the Whampoa Military Academy, then switched to aviation and joined the first class of the Guangdong Aviation School, and was later selected for the Soviet aviation school and the advanced course of the Central Aviation School. He served as an aviation-school instructor, a route commander, deputy director of the Aeronautical Commission and deputy commander-in-chief of the Air Force headquarters, became Air Force commander-in-chief in 1952 (ROC year 41) and Chief of the General Staff in 1957 (ROC year 46).

考入黃埔軍校第一期

heading.zh-Hant: 抗戰與戡亂期間的空中督戰
heading.en: Air operations in the war against Japan and the civil war

body.zh-Hant: 同一份介紹記載，抗戰期間王叔銘在滇西、豫西、鄂西與中原諸戰役中親自督戰；抗戰後於東北、平綏、察北、陝北、蘇北、魯豫的戡亂戰事緊張時，又親臨空中指揮。依公報記錄，他於1946年6月29日獲任空軍副總司令，並兼任空軍總司令部參謀長（日期為公報公告日）。
body.en: The same profile records that during the war against Japan Wang personally supervised operations in the western Yunnan, western Henan, western Hubei and Central Plains campaigns, and that after the war he took command in the air when fighting was tense in the Northeast, Suiyuan–Pingdiquan, northern Chahar, northern Shaanxi, northern Jiangsu and Shandong–Henan. Gazette records show he was appointed Deputy Commander-in-Chief of the Air Force and concurrently Chief of Staff of the Air Force headquarters on 29 June 1946 (gazette announcement date).

heading.zh-Hant: 空軍總司令、參謀總長與八二三戰役
heading.en: Air Force commander, Chief of the General Staff and the 823 campaign

body.zh-Hant: 公報記錄顯示，王叔銘於1952年3月14日獲特任為空軍中將總司令，1954年6月24日連任一次，1957年6月25日特任為陸軍二級上將兼參謀總長，1958年12月31日晉任空軍一級上將。空軍新聞稿稱他受任參謀總長後督令三軍研擬作戰計畫，並於八二三戰役統籌全局、指揮三軍；該稿並稱戰役寫下擊落中共米格機32架、擊沉32艘戰艦的紀錄。
body.en: Gazette records show Wang was appointed Air Force Lieutenant-General and commander-in-chief on 14 March 1952, reappointed for one term on 24 June 1954, appointed Army second-class general and Chief of the General Staff on 25 June 1957, and promoted to Air Force first-class general on 31 December 1958. An Air Force news release says that after taking up the post he ordered the three services to draft operational plans and directed the whole of the 823 campaign, which it says recorded 32 Communist MiGs shot down and 32 warships sunk.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身與早年革命
heading.en: Origins and early revolutionary career

body.zh-Hant: 據湖南省檔案局的人物介紹，程潛出生於湖南醴陵，1904年8月被保送赴日，先後就讀日本振武學校和陸軍士官學校炮兵科第六期，1905年8月在東京加入中國同盟會。1908年12月他受同盟會東京本部委派回國，任同盟會長江上游聯絡員，並赴四川訓練新軍。
body.en: The Hunan Provincial Archives biography says Cheng Qian was born in Liling, Hunan, was sent to Japan in August 1904, studied at the Shinbu Gakko and then the artillery course of the Army Officer Academy (6th class), and joined the Tongmenghui in Tokyo in August 1905. In December 1908 the Tokyo headquarters of the Tongmenghui sent him back to China as liaison for the upper Yangtze, and he went to Sichuan to train the New Army.

citations.quote: 湖南省醴陵县（今醴陵市）人，1882年3月31日出生于醴陵县官庄乡长连冲一户耕读之家
1904年8月保送赴日，先后就读日本振武学校、陆军士官学校炮兵科第六期
于1905年8月在东京加人中国同盟会
1908年12月受同盟会东京本部委派回国，任同盟会长江上游联络员并赴四川训练新军

heading.zh-Hant: 護法、廣東大本營與北伐
heading.en: The constitution-protection war, the Guangdong headquarters and the Northern Expedition

body.zh-Hant: 1917年8月，孫中山在廣州組織護法軍政府，程潛任護法軍湘南總司令。1926年初，他當選國民黨第二屆中央執行委員，並任國民革命軍第六軍軍長，同年7月率部北伐，轉戰湖南、湖北、江西，攻下九江、南昌。1927年1月，他任江右軍總指揮，3月首克南京。
body.en: In August 1917, when Sun Yat-sen formed the constitution-protection military government in Guangzhou, Cheng Qian became commander-in-chief of its southern Hunan army. In early 1926 he was elected to the Kuomintang's second Central Executive Committee and became commander of the National Revolutionary Army's 6th Army; in July he led it north on the Northern Expedition, fighting through Hunan, Hubei and Jiangxi and taking Jiujiang and Nanchang. In January 1927 he became commander of the Right Jiang Army, and Nanjing was first taken in March.

citations.quote: 1917年8月，孙中山在广州组织护法军政府，他任护法军湘南总司令
1926年初，当选为国民党第二届中央执行委员、国民政府委员、军事委员会委员，任国民革命军第六军军长
于7月率部北伐，转战湖南、湖北、江西，攻下九江、南昌
1927年1月任国民革命军江右军总指挥，率部进攻安徽、江苏，3月首克南京

heading.zh-Hant: 抗戰期間的第一戰區與隴海路戰事
heading.en: The First War Area and the Longhai Railway fighting

body.zh-Hant: 檔案局介紹說，1935年12月，程潛出任國民政府參謀總長；七七事變後，他先後任第一戰區司令兼河南省政府主席、軍事委員會天水行營主任等職。中研院近史所的戰役論述記載，徐州會戰後日軍第十四師團渡河進至蘭封附近，第一戰區司令長官程潛以胡宗南、宋希濂等部拒止；日軍攻下蘭封後，程潛決定各軍西撤，蔣中正再令他破壞黃河大堤以阻日軍。
body.en: The archives biography says Cheng became Chief of the General Staff of the National Government in December 1935 and, after the Marco Polo Bridge Incident, served successively as commander of the First War Area and chairman of Henan, director of the Tianshui field headquarters, and other posts. An Academia Sinica study of the early campaigns records that, after the Xuzhou campaign, Japan's 14th Division crossed the Yellow River near Lanfeng and First War Area commander Cheng Qian held it off with units under Hu Zongnan, Song Xilian and others; after Lanfeng fell Cheng decided to withdraw his armies west, and Chiang Kai-shek ordered him to breach the Yellow River dike to hinder the Japanese.

heading.zh-Hant: 戰後與湖南和平起義
heading.en: Postwar posts and the Hunan uprising

body.zh-Hant: 1946年5月，程潛出任國民政府武漢行轅主任。1948年競選副總統失敗後，他於7月就任長沙綏靖公署主任兼湖南省政府主席。1949年6月，他書寫備忘錄，由中共湖南省工委轉呈中共中央，報告湖南和平起義的意圖和部署；8月4日他與國民黨第一兵團司令陳明仁領銜發出起義通電。
body.en: In May 1946 Cheng Qian became director of the National Government's Wuhan field headquarters. After losing the vice-presidential election in 1948 he took office in July as director of the Changsha pacification office and chairman of Hunan. In June 1949 he wrote a memorandum, passed to the Chinese Communist Party Central Committee through its Hunan provincial work committee, reporting his intention and plans for a peaceful uprising in Hunan, and on 4 August he and First Army Group commander Chen Mingren jointly issued the uprising telegram.

citations.quote: 1946年5月出任国民政府武汉行辕主任
1948年竞选副总统失败后，于7月就任长沙绥靖公署主任兼湖南省政府主席
并于1949年6月书写备忘录，由中共湖南省工委转呈中共中央和毛泽东主席
8月4日，当中国人民解放军逼近长沙时，他和国民党第一兵团司令陈明仁领衔发出起义通电

heading.zh-Hant: 參謀總長與河南省主席
heading.en: Chief of the General Staff and Henan chairman

body.zh-Hant: 據日本《ブリタニカ國際大百科事典》小項目條目，程潛在1935至1937年任軍事委員會參謀總長，1937至1939年任河南省政府主席。日本《日本大百科全書》則記他於1928年任湖南省主席，其後歷任軍事委員會委員等職。
body.en: The Japanese Britannica concise entry says Cheng Qian served as chief of the General Staff of the Military Affairs Commission from 1935 to 1937 and as chairman of the Henan provincial government from 1937 to 1939. The Nipponica entry says he became chairman of Hunan in 1928 and later served as a member of the Military Affairs Commission.

heading.zh-Hant: 長沙綏靖公署與湖南和平起義
heading.en: The Changsha Pacification Office and the Hunan uprising

body.zh-Hant: 據湖南日報新媒體的報導，程潛1948年6月任國民黨長沙綏靖公署主任兼湖南省政府主席，7月赴任長沙。1949年8月4日，他與陳明仁領銜的三十七名將領聯名發出起義通電，宣布脫離國民黨政府；8月5日解放軍進駐長沙，湖南和平解放。
body.en: Hunan Daily New Media reports that Cheng Qian became director of the Changsha Pacification Office and chairman of the Hunan provincial government in June 1948 and took up the post in Changsha in July. On 4 August 1949 he and Chen Mingren led 37 generals in issuing an uprising telegram announcing their break with the Kuomintang government; the PLA entered Changsha on 5 August and Hunan was peacefully liberated.

heading.zh-Hant: 軍械處與第十八軍
heading.en: The ordnance office and the 18th Army

body.zh-Hant: 依政府公報任免令，羅卓英於1928年2月1日任軍事委員會軍政廳軍械處籌備科科長，同年4月28日呈請辭職。1933年6月12日，他被派為陸軍第十八軍副軍長；1935年4月5日任陸軍中將，同年9月23日改派為第十八軍軍長。以上日期為公報公告日。
body.en: According to gazette appointment orders, Luo Zhuoying was appointed head of the preparatory section of the ordnance office under the Military Affairs Commission on 1 February 1928 and asked to resign on 28 April. On 12 June 1933 he was assigned deputy commander of the 18th Army; he became Army lieutenant-general on 5 April 1935 and was assigned commander of the 18th Army on 23 September that year. These are gazette announcement dates.

heading.zh-Hant: 1941年上高會戰
heading.en: The 1941 Battle of Shanggao

body.zh-Hant: 據中研院近史所的戰役論述，1941年初日軍決定抽調第十一軍部分師團轉用華北，並於3月中旬發動「短切作戰」，中方稱上高會戰。國軍由第九戰區第十九集團軍總司令羅卓英指揮3個軍計9個半師，全會戰動員兵力約9萬5千人。3月15日拂曉日軍北路自安義進攻奉新；國軍至3月22日起包圍日軍，使日軍遭受重大損失。
body.en: According to an Academia Sinica study of the middle-period campaigns, in early 1941 the Japanese decided to move part of their 11th Army to North China and launched a "short, sharp operation" in mid-March, which the Chinese call the Battle of Shanggao. The Chinese side, under Luo Zhuoying as commander-in-chief of the 19th Army Group of the Ninth War Area, committed three corps (nine and a half divisions) and about 95,000 men over the whole battle. On the dawn of 15 March the Japanese northern column attacked Fengxin from Anyi; from 22 March the Chinese surrounded the Japanese and inflicted heavy losses.

heading.zh-Hant: 南昌攻勢與戰後職務
heading.en: The Nanchang offensive and postwar posts

body.zh-Hant: 中研院同一章節記載，蔣中正令第九戰區先出動有力部隊進出南潯鐵路、再攻取南昌，由第九戰區前敵總司令兼第十九集團軍總司令羅卓英統一指揮。公報另記，羅卓英於1945年8月13日任廣東省政府委員兼主席，1946年1月18日兼廣東省保安司令，同年6月13日晉加陸軍上將，1947年9月20日免省主席，同年12月30日派為東北行轅副主任。
body.en: The same chapter records that Chiang Kai-shek ordered the Ninth War Area to send strong forces to the Nanchang–Xunyang railway and then retake Nanchang, under the unified command of Luo Zhuoying as front-line commander of the Ninth War Area and commander of the 19th Army Group. The gazette also records that Luo became a member and chairman of the Guangdong provincial government on 13 August 1945, concurrently commander of provincial peace-preservation forces on 18 January 1946, was promoted Army general on 13 June 1946, was relieved as chairman on 20 September 1947, and was assigned deputy director of the Northeast field headquarters on 30 December 1947.

heading.zh-Hant: 1942年緬甸遠征軍與仁安羌之戰
heading.en: The 1942 Burma expeditionary force and the Battle of Yenangyaung

body.zh-Hant: 據風傳媒賈忠偉的評論，1942年緬甸戰役中，羅卓英任中國遠征軍第一路司令長官；仁安羌戰役裡，新編第38師第113團的調動命令均由他下達，他並向新38師下令赴賓河附近救援被圍英軍。同文提到，他與林蔚在4月20日分別致電蔣介石報告戰況。
body.en: In a commentary by Jia Zhongwei in Storm Media, Luo Zhuoying was commander-in-chief of the First Route of the Chinese Expeditionary Force during the 1942 Burma campaign; at Yenangyaung the orders moving the 113th Regiment of the New 38th Division all came from him, and he ordered the division to relieve British troops besieged near the Pin River. The article adds that he and Lin Wei each wired Chiang Kai-shek on 20 April.

heading.zh-Hant: 九一八事變：瀋陽北大營作戰
heading.en: The Mukden Incident: the battle at Beidaying

body.zh-Hant: 據政治大學李宗儒的碩士論文，1931年9月18日晚間，日軍進入瀋陽東北邊的柳條湖，並向北大營發動猛攻，展開北大營戰役。當時任東北邊防軍司令長官公署參謀長的榮臻感到事態嚴重，馬上電話請示遠在北平的張學良副總司令，得到避免衝突、不以武力報復的訓令。
body.en: According to Lee Tsung-Ju's master's thesis at National Chengchi University, on the evening of 18 September 1931 Japanese troops entered Liutiaohu northeast of Shenyang and launched a fierce assault on the Beidaying barracks. Rong Zhen, then chief of staff of the Northeastern Frontier Army commander-in-chief's headquarters, judged the situation grave and at once telephoned Deputy Commander Zhang Xueliang in Beiping, receiving an order to avoid conflict and not retaliate by force.

heading.zh-Hant: 事變後的錦州行署
heading.en: The Jinzhou offices after the incident

body.zh-Hant: 事變爆發後，張學良在錦州設立東北邊防軍司令長官公署與遼寧省政府行署，分由張作相、米春霖負責。論文寫道，榮臻以東北邊防軍參謀長的身分與兩人一同肩負軍政大任，意在展現堅守遼西的決心。
body.en: After the incident broke out, Zhang Xueliang set up the Northeastern Frontier Army commander-in-chief's headquarters and the Liaoning provincial government office at Jinzhou, entrusting them to Zhang Zuoxiang and Mi Chunlin respectively. The thesis says Rong Zhen, as the Frontier Army's chief of staff, shared the military and administrative duties with them, intended to show resolve to hold western Liaoning.

body.zh-Hant: 1937年11月17日，蔣鼎文獲特派為軍事委員會委員長西安行營主任，並免駐閩綏靖主任；1938年6月15日起任陝西省政府主席，6月30日任陝西全省保安司令。1939年1月25日，他卸西安行營主任；1941年6月19日免陝西省政府主席，同年8月16日免保安司令。
body.en: On 17 November 1937 Jiang Dingwen was specially assigned as director of the Chairman's Xi'an field headquarters of the Military Affairs Commission and relieved of the Fujian pacification post; on 15 June 1938 he was appointed chairman of the Shaanxi provincial government and on 30 June commander of the provincial peace-preservation forces. He left the Xi'an field headquarters on 25 January 1939, and was relieved as provincial chairman on 19 June 1941 and as peace-preservation commander on 16 August 1941.

heading.zh-Hant: 1944年中原會戰的檢討報告
heading.en: The 1944 Central Plains campaign report

body.zh-Hant: 國史館館刊論文引述，第一戰區司令長官蔣鼎文在戰役結束後的檢討報告中，提到會戰期間豫西山地民眾到處截擊軍隊；該報告題為關於中原會戰潰敗之檢討報告，註記時間為1944年6月。論文另稱蔣鼎文等高層將領經營商業活動、與民爭利。
body.en: An Academia Historica journal article quotes a post-battle review by Jiang Dingwen, then commander-in-chief of the First War Area, noting that mountain villagers in western Henan intercepted troops everywhere during the campaign; the report is titled as a review of the defeat in the Central Plains battle and is dated June 1944. The article also says that senior generals including Jiang engaged in commercial activities at the expense of local people.

citations.quote: 第一戰區司令長官蔣鼎文在戰役結束後的檢討報告中，就提到了農民倒戈相向的恐怖景象
此次會戰期間，所意想不到之特別現象，即豫西山地民眾到處截擊軍隊
